verdicts.originalText: The bubble heals all nearby teammates (not Sigewinne herself) on every bounce. When it finishes bouncing it heals only Sigewinne, for 50% of her Max HP — that single final heal isn't drawn as a separate marker. Held casts add a small healing boost (+5% / +10%) on the early bounces, which also isn't shown. Sigewinne also picks up Bond of Life from this skill's Sourcewater Droplets, which the planner doesn't track.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the one-time self-heal (50% Max HP) when the bubble stops bouncing, the held-cast healing boost on early bounces (+5% / +10%), and Bond of Life from the skill's Sourcewater Droplets.
verdicts.rationale: Three real gaps compress into one 'Not modeled' list: the final self-heal has no summon-end/final-tick trigger primitive, the hold-tier healing bonus has no decaying per-tick primitive, and Bond of Life is out of scope by constitution — all keep/rewrite (CANNOT list), none FROZEN. The opening sentence describes working behavior (the per-bounce team heal IS authored as a summonTick heal on teamExcludingSelf and renders), so it is dropped per the no-working-behavior rule. Character and ability names stripped since the panel shows both.

verdicts.originalText: The CR / CD buffs fire when Sigewinne heals (Rebound Hydrotherapy bubble bounces). The planner doesn't simulate per-bounce heal events, so these are manual-trigger windows — toggle them on for canonical Bubblebalm rotations. Sigewinne C6 is the only practical onHeal consumer in the corpus; the other potential consumers (Gaming C2, Wriothesley A4/C2, Charlotte C1) require overheal/HP-state primitives the planner can't simulate.
verdicts.proposedText: The CR / CD buffs come from healing (the skill's bubble bounces), which isn't tracked as its own event, so they don't fire automatically — toggle them on for Bubblebalm rotations.
verdicts.rationale: onHeal is an unconsumed trigger on the CANNOT list, and the buffs are authored with a manual trigger — so per the wave-3 lesson the honest phrasing is 'toggle them on manually' (they render once enabled), not 'Not modeled.' The third sentence — a corpus-wide rationale about why other onHeal consumers (Gaming/Wriothesley/Charlotte) aren't built — is pure curator reasoning that already lives verbatim in _curatorNotes, so it is demoted out of the user-facing text. 'planner' avoided in favor of the-timeline voice; character/constellation/ability names stripped since the panel shows them.
